name: kettlebell single leg deadlift pass
description: A single-leg deadlift where you pass a kettlebell from hand to hand. It trains balance and the hip hinge.
instructions: Stand on one leg holding a kettlebell in one hand.
Hinge at the hips and reach the bell toward the floor.
Pass the bell to the other hand below your knee.
Stand back up using your glute and hamstring.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
